info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Loyalty Points Expires-v3-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Expiration API provides insights into the upcoming expiration of loyalty points for customers. Businesses can utilize this API to effectively manage and notify users about their loyalty points, ensuring customer engagement and retention. It allows developers to retrieve relevant data on points that are soon to expire, empowering them to create targeted marketing campaigns or alerts. Typical consumers include hotels and loyalty program managers seeking to enhance customer experiences and reduce point lapses.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve points that have expired in the system. It's useful for understanding point expiration and managing user rewards effectively.

requestBody.description: The request body for the expiration of points operation. It is expected to contain necessary parameters in JSON format to specify which points to expire.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the expiration information for points.
